title: Hoarfrost Boots
summary: You cannot slip and fall Prone from walking on Ice.

fields.Hoarfrost Balance: Prevents falls caused by traversing icy terrain. Other sources of Prone are unaffected.
fields.Acquisition: In a display case in the Inquisitor’s Chamber at Crèche Y’llek.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
